attempts.summary: Created a local root CA named "OS Comparison Root CA" (RSA 4096 key + self-signed X.509 cert, 10-year validity, CA:TRUE) on node1 at /etc/os-comparison-ca/, installed its certificate into the system trust store via /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/ and update-ca-certificates, and verified trust with openssl verify. Then executed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id and health, triggered a native systemctl reboot, confirmed disconnect/reconnect, proved the boot_id changed, and re-verified the CA files and trust-store linkage/openssl verification post-restart.
